description.ko:
"넌 천재다"

어릴 때 들었던 말이 독이었다.
엔크리드는 기사를 꿈꿨다.
헛된 꿈이라는 건 금세 알았다.

"그런 실력으로 칼밥을 먹겠다고?"

누군가는 비웃고.

"그만둬라."

누군가는 조언했다.

그럼에도 빛 바랜 꿈은 그대로였다.

덜 자고 더 뛰고 더 휘둘렀다.

그리 살던 어느 날이었다.
전장에서 목이 찔려 죽은 뒤였다.

다시 눈을 뜬 엔크리드는 죽기 전 '오늘' 아침에 돌아와 있었다.
description.pt-br: "Você é um gênio." Essas palavras que ele ouviu quando era criança eram veneno. Encrid sonhava em ser um cavaleiro, mas logo percebeu que era fútil. "Quer viver pela espada com esse nível de habilidade?" Uns davam risada dele. "Apenas desista." Outros aconselhavam contra. Mesmo assim, o sonho dele não morreu. Ele dormia menos, corria mais, e se esforçava pra caramba. Um dia, morreu, com uma espada perfurando sua garganta. Encrid abriu os olhos novamente para a "manhã de hoje".

Was wie ein gewöhnlicher Tag begann, wird auf den Kopf gestellt, als eine mysteriöse Katastrophe die Erde heimsucht und Soo Ho Park auf einen anderen Planeten befördert. Mit der Zeit lernt er, sich anzupassen und um sein Überleben in dieser fremden Welt zu kämpfen. Doch eines Tages wird Soo Ho genauso plötzlich wieder auf die Erde zurückgeholt, wie er auf dem neuen Planeten gelandet ist. Schnell erfährt er, dass eine Rückkehr zu seinem vergangenen Leben nicht möglich ist, denn die Erde befindet sich in einem ständigen Kampf mit Monstern, denen es gelungen ist, den Planeten zu infiltrieren. description.en:
Who knew that the game I designed for fun with my friend in middle school would later become a monster that would swallow up the entire world? Taejun, who has been living a tough life with his younger sister, loses all of what he saved due to a lease fraud. In despair, he curses, "To hell with this fucking world!!" while looking at Namsan… but the next day, the curse came true! Namsan suddenly turned into a large sinkhole where man hunting golems started endlessly spawning!! The world has turned into a living hell, but Taejun realizes that these golems may be a mob he created in the past? A strategy that only he knows of. Save the world, or save just yourself.

"Неужели игра воплотилась в реальность?"

На следующий день к его удивлению проклятье подействовало (?). На Намсане появилось дыра, из которой полезли големы и начали атаковать людей. Так мир превратился в ад. description.en:
Around 50 years ago, after the Korean War, Demon World Gates appeared abruptly all over the world.  
Through the Gates, Demon creatures appeared. These otherworldly beings, utterly impervious to modern weaponry, rained destruction across the world.  
Just when all hope for humanity was lost, the "Masters" awakened: humanity's one chance for salvation.  
With the appearance of these entities, the world began to change rapidly.   
  
Fast forward to 50 years later-  
We meet Gang Kyu Sung, who had worked for a small company as a deputy who could never catch a lucky break nor even got promoted.   
That is, until he happens to awaken as a Master…?  
  
A Rank 5 Master who had once been ignored and scorned-  
Thus begins the uprising of a man who works his way up from the bottom!

description.ru:
Около 50 лет назад, после Корейской войны, по всему миру начали появляться «Врата из мира демонов». Через эти «врата» стали прорываться в наш мир демоны и демонические существа. Эти потусторонние существа, совершенно невосприимчивые к современному оружию, несли разрушения по всему миру. И в тот момент, когда всякая надежда была потеряна, пробудились мастера — единственный шанс людей на спасение. С появлением этих сущностей мир начал быстро меняться. 50 лет спустя. Парень по имени Кан Гю Сон работает в небольшой компании без единого отпуска и даже не смеет мечтать о повышении. Так было до тех пор, пока он не пробудился как мастер. Мастер 5 ранга, которого некогда игнорировали и презирали… Так начнётся восхождение человека, прокладывающего себе путь с самых низов до вершины!

description.en:
Fated out of necessity, he and she met.

BANG!

He is a desert. A vicious animal. Above all else, he is the noble but unrecognized successor to the Sultan. He has owned her for one year. And now he moves to own her for the rest of her life.

---
It was inevitable that they'd meet by chance. *Bam!* He's a desert, a violent beast, and the Sultan's heir, someone more important than everyone else and yet still acknowledged by nobody. He owns her for one year, but is trying to keep her forever.

“Friedrich Dürrenmatt once said, ‘It is only in love and murder that we still remain sincere.’ Since you’re still alive, does that mean I love you?” says the man that's done with playing hide and seek, Ashan.

"Oh my, that's a scary confession. There isn't anything in the contract about having to spend the night here though," says the woman trying to escape, Seoyoon.

description.en:
Philomel—the fake princess—conspires with her mother to impersonate the imperial princess and cause a war between the Mage Tower and the Empire.
Once her crimes were exposed, she was sentenced to execution.
A death truly befitting of a wicked—

“Even if the Philomel within the book had done some wrong, it wasn’t enough to warrant death!”

Philomel yelled and threw the book she'd been reading.
She had simply been curious about a book she'd picked up in the garden, but the contents of the book stated that she would die!
Although she wanted to believe it was nothing but fiction, everything that happened from that moment onwards went just like in the book.

“Since it has come to this… my goal is to survive!”

Will Philomel be able to discover the origins of the suspicious book and live on?
___
After finding a mysterious book in the imperial garden, Princess Philomel not only discovers that the book's villain shares her name, but that other events in the story are coming true too. Now, she believes that she's an imposter and that the real princess will take her rightful place, leading to the execution of Philomel the Fake! So to avoid a tragic death, she has to make sure the rest of the book doesn't come true. Can this fake princess change what's already been written?
description.fr:
Philomel — la fausse princesse — complote avec sa mère pour se faire passer pour la princesse impériale et provoquer une guerre entre la Tour des Mages et l'Empire. Une fois ses crimes exposés, elle est condamnée à l'exécution. Une mort vraiment digne d'une méchante...

‘Même si la Philomel du livre a fait quelque chose de mal, ce n'est pas assez pour justifier la mort!»

Philomel a crié et a jeté le livre qu'elle lisait. Elle avait simplement été curieuse à propos d'un livre qu'elle avait ramassé dans le jardin, mais le contenu du livre disait qu'elle allait mourir! Bien qu'elle ait voulu croire que ce n'était que de la fiction, tout ce qui s'est passé à partir de ce moment-là s'est déroulé comme dans le livre.

«Puisqu'on en est arrivé là... mon but est de survivre!»

Philomel parviendra-t-elle à découvrir les origines du livre suspect et à survivre?
description.id: Setelah bersekongkol dengan ibunya dan memicu perang antara kekaisaran dan menara sihir, Philomel si 'putri palsu' dihukum mati atas semua kejahatannya... Begitulah isi dari buku mencurigakan yang dipungut oleh Philomel di taman. Ia ingin memercayai bahwa cerita di dalam buku itu hanyalah fiksi, tapi semakin hari kejadian di dunia nyata semakin menyerupai buku itu. Agar tidak bernasib sama dengan Philomel yang ada di dalam buku, Philomel memutuskan untuk berusaha bertahan hidup. Akankah hidupnya berjalan sama seperti dengan buku mencurigakan itu?
description.ko:
어미와 공모하여 황녀를 사칭하고, 
마탑과 제국을 이간질하여 전쟁을 일으킨 '가짜 황녀', 필로멜. 
그녀는 모든 죄가 들통나자 사형 당한다. 실로 악당에 어울리는......

"내가, 아니 책 속의 필로멜이 잘못을 했기로서니 죽일 만큼은 아니잖아!"

필로멜은 괴성을 지르며 읽던 책을 던졌다. 
정원에서 주운 수상한 책이 궁금했을 뿐인데 
자신, 아니 책 속의 필로멜 황녀가 죽는다니! 

허구일 뿐이라고 믿고 싶지만, 
어쩐지 이후 일어나는 모든 일들은 그 책과 똑 닮아있는데.

"이렇게 된 이상... 목표는 생존 뿐이야!" 

과연 필로멜은 수상한 책의 정체를 밝히고 자신의 인생을 찾을 수 있을것인가.
description.pl:
Philomel - fałszywa księżniczka - spiskowała ze swoją matką, by podszyć się pod cesarską księżniczkę i wywołać wojnę między Wieżą Magów, a Imperium.
Gdy jej zbrodnie zostały ujawnione, została skazana na śmierć.
Konic godny nikczemnika...
"Nawet jeśli Philomel z książki zrobiła coś złego, to nie było to wystarczające, aby uzasadnić wyrok śmierci!"
Philomel krzyknęła i rzuciła książkę, którą czytała.
Była po prostu ciekawa książki, którą znalazła w ogrodzie, ale jej treść mówiła, że umrze!
Choć chciała wierzyć, że to nic innego jak bajka, wszystko, co wydarzyło się od tego momentu, przebiegało dokładnie tak, jak w książce.
"Skoro do tego doszło... moim celem jest przetrwanie!".
Czy Philomel uda się odkryć pochodzenie podejrzanej książki i żyć dalej?
description.ru:
Сговорившись с матерью, Филломель всю свою жизнь выдавала себя за родную дочь императора. А когда обман вскрывается, самозванка разжигает конфликт между Империей и Башней магов.
В конце концов фальшивую Принцессу казнят за все её грехи.
Таково было содержание книги, которую маленькая принцесса Филломель нашла в саду.
Возмущению принцессы не было предела!
Вот только события из книги начинают сбываться...
description.vi: Philomel – công chúa giả mạo – âm mưu cùng mẹ đóng giả thân phận công chúa và là người đã gây ra cuộc chiến giữa Tháp Pháp sư và Đế quốc. Khi tội ác của cô bị vạch trần, cô đã bị kết án tử hình. Cái chết này thật sự phù hợp với một kẻ ác- “Kể cả khi Philomel đã làm những điều sai trái, thì vẫn không đáng để cô phải chết như thế!” Philomel hét lên và ném cuốn sách mà mình đang đọc. Cô chỉ đơn giản là tò mò về cuốn sách mà bản thân vô tình nhặt được trong vườn, nhưng nội dung của cuốn sách lại nói rằng cô ấy sẽ phải chết! Mặc dù muốn tin rằng đó chỉ là hư cấu, nhưng mọi thứ lại diễn ra giống như trong cuốn sách ấy vậy. “Vì đã đến nước này… mục tiêu của mình là phải sống sót!” Liệu Philomel có thể khám phá ra nguồn gốc của cuốn sách đáng ngờ này và sống tiếp hay không?
description.pt-br: Philomel, a 'princesa falsa' que conspirou com sua mãe para se passar por princesa imperial, causou uma guerra ao separar a Torre Mágica do Império. Quando ela é considerada culpada de todos os seus crimes, ela é condenada à morte. Realmente digna de uma vilã... "Eu, não, Philomel no livro fiz algo errado, então não é o suficiente para me matar!" Philomel gritou e jogou o livro que estava lendo. Ela estava apenas curiosoa sobre o livro suspeito que pegou no jardim, mas ela, não, a princesa Philomel do livro morreu! Quero acreditar que é apenas uma ficção, mas de alguma forma tudo o que acontece depois se assemelha ao que está escrito no livro. "Agora que está assim... meu único objetivo é sobreviver!" Philomel será capaz de revelar o que aquele livro suspeito diz e reivindicar sua vida?

description.en:
I was born as the villainess's daughter inside a novel. When I was born, Mom's wrongdoings have already been revealed leading to her confinement in the tower, and soon she'll receive a miserable death at the hands of the main characters. I held her hand while looking over my mother who searched for her ex-husband until her dying breath. My small hand entwined Mom's rough one and she finally turned to me with a warm gaze.

"I understand you, Mom."

"..."

"Don't struggle anymore, and rest well."

And don't wait for something like Dad who won't come. At my words, a tear fell from my mother's eye and soon, she comfortably rested. As the novel's villainess is dead, I, her daughter, will also die tomorrow night by those people. And then the second part of the novel will start. A novel where the main characters go on adventures, love and become happy at the first part. But I don't want to die and I have no thoughts of letting the second part flow as it is.

"It's fine even if I'm this mean."

It's a life where I don't know when I'd die anyway, so might as well change how the novel's second part goes.

---
Born as the daughter of a villainess, Daphne lived her entire life hated by everyone she's ever crossed paths with. After her mother's pitiful death, Daphne knows that a similar fate awaits her-- but what did she ever do to deserve it? Why does she have to be branded as a wicked child when she's done no wrong? In order to survive, Daphne will have to take her life into her own hands... but will she be able to make a name for herself, or will she be known as the villainess's daughter forever?

description.fr:
Je suis née fille d'une méchante femme dans un roman. À la naissance, ma mère avait déjà été exposée à ses mauvaises actions et était confinée à la flèche, et allait bientôt faire face à une mort misérable entre les mains des personnages principaux. J'ai regardé ma mère, qui était toujours à la recherche de son ex-mari jusqu'au moment où elle est morte et lui a tenu les mains. Ma petite main s'est emmêlée avec la main rugueuse de ma mère et ses yeux pleins de chaleur se sont tournés vers moi.

«Je comprends, Maman.»

«...»

«Ne souffre plus, dors bien.»

N'attendez pas le papa qui ne viendra pas. Des larmes coulèrent des yeux de ma mère à mes paroles, et bientôt elle s'endormit paisiblement. Puisque la «Wicked Woman» du roman est maintenant morte, moi, sa fille, je serai battue à mort par des gens demain soir. Et la deuxième partie du roman va commencer. Un roman chaleureux dans lequel les enfants des personnages principaux commencent leur aventure pleine de bonheur. Mais je ne voulais pas mourir et je n'avais aucune intention de laisser l'histoire se dérouler de cette façon.

«C'est bien d'être méchant.»

J'ai décidé de réécrire complètement la deuxième partie du roman, car c'est une vie qui peut être tuée à tout moment de toute façon.

description.tr:
Bir romanda kötü bir kadının kızı olarak doğdum. Annem doğduğunda zaten onun kötü işlerine maruz kalmıştı ve kuleye hapsedildi ve yakında ana karakterlerin elinde sefil bir ölümle karşı karşıya kalacaktı. Öldüğü ana kadar hala eski kocasını arayan anneme baktım ve ellerini tuttum. Küçük elim annemin kaba eline dolandı ve sıcaklıkla dolu gözleri bana döndü. “Anlıyorum anne.” “….” “Artık acı çekme, iyi uyu.” Gelmeyecek olan babamı bekleme. Sözlerimle annemin gözünden yaşlar düştü ve çok geçmeden huzur içinde uykuya daldı. Romanın “Kötü Kadın” artık öldüğüne göre kızı, yarın gece insanlar tarafından dövülerek öldürüleceğim. Ve romanın ikinci bölümü başlayacak. Ana karakterlerin kızının mutluluk dolu macerasına başladığı sıcacık bir roman. Ama ölmek istemiyordum ve hikayenin bu şekilde akmasına izin vermeye hiç niyetim yoktu. “Kötü olmak sorun değil.” Romanın ikinci bölümünü tamamen yeniden yazmaya karar verdim çünkü bu her an ölebilecek bir hayat.

description.cs: Chu Sang Woo pracuje společně s dalšími studenty na prezentaci, na které se ale nikdo z nich nepodílel. Sang Woo tomu tedy udělá přítrž a všechna jména příživníků z prezentace vymaže. Jenže jedním z příživníků je Jang Jae Young, který měl letos promovat a odjet na stáž do zahraničí. Když se to Jae Young dozví, rozhodne se mu pomstít a udělat mu ze života peklo. Čím víc času, ale Jae Young tráví se Sang Wooem, tím víc je z něj zmatený a začne mezi nimi vznikat zvláštní přitažlivost...
description.en:
Computer science major Chu Sangwoo is the epitome of an inflexible and strict rule-abiding person. While working on a liberal arts group project with freeloaders who don’t put in any effort, Sangwoo reasonably decides to remove their names from the final presentation.  
  
But he didn’t imagine how involved he would become with the person whose study-abroad plans were messed up because of that project. The involved person: the campus star who everyone knows, Department of Design’s Jang Jaeyoung. He has everything from skills, looks, family background and good relationships except for 1 big problem: Chu Sangwoo.   
  
What happens when an engineer and an artist whose personalities are like oil and water have to work together? Jang Jaeyoung is like a semantic error in the perfect world of Chu Sangwoo. Will Sangwoo be able to debug this?

---

description.en:
"You may be my wife but, I won't lay a single finger on you."

"Really? Then can I touch you?"

"...What?"

About 20 years later, the world will be in ruins because of the invasion of the beasts. There's only one way to stop the destruction. To marry the duke who is called a monster, and have his child who will become the hero in the future!

Elena who saw a glimpse of the future succeeded in marrying him but...

"Are we going to continue to not do anything?"

I wanted to get it quickly out of the way, but my husband's impregnable fortress is stronger than I could have imagined!

"Take it off! Why aren't you taking it off?! Are your clothes part of your skin?"

Will Elena be able to safely give birth to the hero and save the world?
description.ru:
— Вы можете стать моей женой, но я не прикоснусь к вам.
— Неужели? Тогда могу ли я прикасаться к вам?
— … Простите?

Примерно через 20 лет из-за нашествия демонов мир будет разрушен и есть лишь один способ предотвратить разрушение.
Выйти замуж за Герцога, известного как чудовище, и родить ему ребёнка, который вырастет и станет будущим воином.

— Этот брак… Я сделаю это.
Элен, которая видела будущее, решила выйти замуж за Герцога-Монстра и родить ему ребёнка, чтобы спасти мир, вот только…

— Мы и дальше ничего не будем делать?

Она думала, что сможет справиться с этим, однако неприступная, словно крепость, оборона её мужа не поддавалась воображению!

— Сними это! Почему “нет”?! Это что, часть твоей кожи?!

Сможет ли Элен в итоге благополучно родить воина и спасти мир?

description.en: School is home to judgmental eyes and home a source of abuse. But that's ok because Junyeong Yun found an abandoned home where she could study to her heart's content. Unfortunately, soon after, Beomjin Kwon, the town's most notorious delinquent, has also begun using the home to catch up on sleep. As the two are forced to coexist, they come to learn about their reasons for avoiding others.
description.id:
Semua hal pertama yang selalu kuingat adalah ketika bersamamu.

Dari musim panas pada usia 18 tahun yang aku belum tahu apa-apa, hingga musim panas pada usia 31 tahun ini, yang aku telah mengetahui banyak hal., Namun, pada musim-musim yang berlalu tanpa dirimu itu yang tertanam dalam hatiku hanya ketika bersamamu.

“Tidak ada gunanya bagimu mengenal diriku”

Dengan wajah yang tanpa ekspresi, kau mendorongku pergi lagi seperti itu. Tapi kau tidak pernah tahu apa yang aku rasakan selama hari-hari tanpa dirimu. Kemudian sekarang kau ingin membuatku merasakannya lagi. 

“Kau bertanya apa aku membutuhkan seorang pria? Apakah kau akan menjadi pria itu jika aku mengiyakan pertanyaanmu?"

Kau harus mengenalku yang berusia 31 tahun ini. Karena saat ini kau sedang memandangku dengan mata yang seolah tidak pernah mengenalku sama sekali. 

“Kau ini pandai sekali membuat orang jadi gila.”

Karena selama kau telah ada di sisiku, senja yang temaram pun menjadi begitu hangat menyinari hatiku.
description.pt-br: Eles se conheceram no colégio, mas vão se separar e se reencontrar quando forem adultos. Toda primeira vez que quero me lembrar de algo, acabo pensando em você. Do verão de 18 anos, quando não sabia nada, até o verão de 31…. “Ficar perto de mim não vai te fazer nenhum bem.” Você me afastou com cara de choro, mas ainda não sabe o que aguentei naqueles dias incontáveis porque nos aproximamos. Então você está repetindo a mesma futilidade de novo. “Você perguntou se eu precisava de um homem? Se necessário, você será meu?” “Você tem que conhecer meu eu de 31 anos.” “Você é bom em deixar as pessoas loucas.”

description.en: Due to a halfhearted and immature decision made by her mother, Irie was set up to marry the son of her mother’s friend. This all began starting when she was 5 years old. She and the boy grew up together until Kang moved overseas due to his father’s job. After 10 years, Irie and Kang are reunited when they are 22 and 18, respectively. Can they be a good match for each other despite the four year age gap and their strikingly different personalities, tastes, and ways of thinking, notwithstanding the sour note that they left their relationship on when they were little?

description.en:
Her family used all their money for her extravagance and luxuries and brought a crisis of bankruptcy. While trying to figure out how to pay off their debts, she found a leaflet from the duke looking for a lost child. The reward is so much money that she could play and eat even after she payed off her debts! Following the memories of reading this book, right away, Lizelle picked up the boy who was caught in a trash dump in a poor village. She took the lost Lapel and went to the duke.

"This is the child the Duke is looking for."

Duke Chester said, looking at me with a doubtful glaze, "I need confirmation, so you should stay with my nephew in this house for the time being."

The strange cohabitation of the three people started like that. However, Lapel keeps thinking of her as a mother and won't let her leave.

"Let's get married."

Lizelle was startled by the unexpected words, "Are you insane? Did you drink?"

"One year. If you perform a contract marriage for one year, I will pay you ten times the amount of the rewards you were given."

"Can I call you 'honey'?"

And the contract marriage and marital life began. But why are his eyes constantly changing? Why do you keep coming every night!

---
Notorious for her extravagant spending, Wilhazelle Fossier drove her house to complete financial ruin. To pay her family's debt, she resolves to collect a bounty from the wealthy Duke Heillos by finding his missing nephew. Although her search is successful, until the skeptical duke can confirm the young boy's identity, Wilhazelle must spend one month living at the Heillos manor. But when one month turns into one year and a contract marriage, she starts to wonder if the money is worth it!

description.fr:
Sa famille a utilisé tous leurs argents pour des extravagances et du luxe, ce qui a provoqué leur faillite… Alors qu'elle essayait de rembourser leurs dettes, elle trouvât un prospectus du Duc qui recherchait un enfant perdu. La récompense était si généreuse qu'avec ça, ils pourraient vivre confortablement même après avoir remboursé leurs dettes! Suite aux souvenirs de la lecture de ce livre, tout de suite, Lizelle retrouva le garçon qui était coincé dans un pauvre village. Elle le prit donc avec elle, afin de toucher la récompense. «C'est l'enfant que le duc recherche.» Le duc Chester étant dubitatif, il l'obligea à rester avec l'enfant dans sa demeure le temps de prouver que cet enfant est bien le sien. L'étrange cohabitation de ces trois personnes commença alors comme ça…

Hobi berfoya-foya Lizelle membuat keluarganya terjerat utang di lintah darah. Sialnya, aku merasuk ke dalam tubuhnya setelah semuanya telanjur kacau! Lalu, aku melihat pengumuman anak hilang beserta imbalannya... Aku tahu siapa dan di mana dia! Raphelion Heillos—si tokoh utama tampan, hebat, dari keluarga Duke, dan yang jelas sekarang dia... masih ada di tempat pembuangan sampah! Aku akan memulangkannya, dapat imbalan, bayar utang, dan hidup makmur sebagai bangsawan! Sayangnya, rencana simpel itu dikacaukan Chester Heillos—paman Raphelion.

description.ko:
'허영심에 가득 찬 웨르아젤 프로시에' 

그것이 내 별명이었다.
정확히 말하자면 내가 빙의하기 전 웨르아젤의 별명.
웨르아젤 진 빚을 수습하기 위해 백방으로 돈을 구할 방법을 찾던 도중!
공작가에서 잃어버린 아이를 찾는다는 전단지를 발견했다.

사례금은 빚을 청산하고도 펑펑 쓸 수 있는 돈.
냉큼 원작 남주인 아이를 주워 공작 가에 데리고 왔는데…

“이 아이가 라펠리온이라는 걸 어떻게 확신합니까.”

공작이 나를 사기꾼으로 취급하는 것으로 모자라,

“한 달 동안 이 저택에서 함께 지내시죠.”

당장 사기가 아니라는 증명을 할 수 없으니
한 달 동안 같이 지내잔다.

그런데!

“결혼하죠.
 딱 1년 동안만 계약 결혼을 해주면 사례금의 10배를 얹어 주죠.”

이제는 나한테 결혼까지 하잰다.

“여보라고 부르면 될까요?”

일 년 동안만 결혼한다면 사례금의 열배를 준다는데 당연히 승낙해야지!
그렇게 시작된 일 년 동안의 계약 결혼.

그런데 왜 자꾸 눈빛이 낯뜨겁게 변하는 건데?
왜 자꾸 밤마다 찾아오는 건데?

description.ru:
Ее семья жила на широкую руку и в скором времени обанкротились. Пытаясь придумать, как расплатиться с долгами, она нашла листовку от герцога, который искал потерявшегося ребенка. Награда - столько денег, что можно играть и есть даже после выплаты долгов! По воспоминаниям о прочтении этой книги, Лизель сразу же нашла мальчика, деревенской свалке. Она взяла потерянного Лапеля и пошла к герцогу. Так началось странное сожительство трех людей. Однако Лапель продолжает думать обо мне как о матери и не хочет ее оставлять. "Давай поженимся". Лизель была поражена неожиданными словами. "Ты с ума сошел? Ты пил?" "1 год. Если ты заключишь контрактный брак на один год, я заплачу тебе 10-кратную сумму вознаграждения". Так начался брак по контракту и супружеская жизнь. Но почему мои глаза постоянно меняются? Почему ты продолжаешь приходить каждую ночь!

Para pagar a dívida de sua família, ela resolve coletar uma recompensa do rico duque Heilos encontrando seu sobrinho desaparecido. Embora sua busca seja bem-sucedida, até que o duque cético possa confirmar a identidade do jovem, Lizelle deve passar um mês morando na mansão Heilos. description.zh-hk:
‘虛榮心滿滿的韋爾阿澤爾·普羅西耶’，這是我的別名。準確來說，這是我穿越之前，韋爾阿澤爾的別名。
為了替韋爾阿澤爾還債，我千方百計尋找掙錢的辦法！這時我發現了公爵家尋找丟失的孩子的告示。
而高額的報酬足夠將債務還清。撿到原作中的男主後本想帶到公爵家…“你怎麼就確信這孩子是拉菲利翁。”
公爵不僅把我當成騙子，還對我說“你就在這裡住一個月吧。”無法立刻證明我不是個騙子，我只好同意了。
可是！ “我們結婚吧。只要和我契約結婚一年，我就給你十倍報酬。”現在他竟然讓我和他結婚。
“我可以叫你老婆嗎？”他說過只要結婚一年，就會給我十倍報酬，我當然沒法拒絕啊。
就這樣我們開始了為期一年的契約婚姻。可是為什麼感覺他的目光變得灼熱？為什麼總是夜裡來找我？

description.en:
My friend stole my boyfriend and then dared to hand me a wedding invitation with a smile? Ha! I had a blast enjoying my revenge and came home and fell asleep but...when I woke up I was in the body of the Villainess of a Romance Fantasy novel who has everything: appearance, assets, and intelligence. The only thing this girl lacked was the insight to judge a man. Throw the bastard Prince away to the main female lead and let us just enjoy the luxury of power and money!

---
From growing up in a dysfunctional family to being cheated on, Sojin never had it easy. So after waking up in the body of villainess Reilynn Candmion, daughter of the empire’s wealthiest duke, all she wants is to revel in her riches. But something feels amiss when the story’s heroine, Iris, constantly starts fights with her — from stealing her dress to seducing her fiancé. Reilynn wants no drama, but Iris and her four love interests won’t leave her alone! Can’t a girl just wanna have fun?

description.en:
After spending most of her youth fielding the attention of countless wealthy suitors, Suhee Kim finally finds true love with a steady boyfriend named Jinsu Han. But then tragedy strikes, and Suhee is murdered in cold blood.  
To Suhee's surprise, she is immediately reincarnated as a baby girl named Sanghee Kim, who just so happens to be a princess! Plus, she is fully conscious of her past life. There's just one problem: in this society, women are seen as totally inferior, even princesses. Appalled by the treatment of women, Sanghee is determined to change the kingdom's patriarchal ways. Will Sanghee be able to succeed, or will she be stuck living her second life being treated as a lowly woman?

description.de: Es war nur eine Nacht. Eine Nacht lang war Astelle mit ihrer großen Liebe Kaisen verheiratet und damit Kaiserin. Dennoch bleibt ihr keine andere Wahl, als Kaisens plötzlichem Wunsch nach einer Scheidung nachzugeben. Sie flüchtet auf das ländliche Anwesen ihres Großvaters, der ihr als einziges Familienmitglied nach der Scheidung nicht den Rücken gekehrt hat. Nach einer einzigen Nacht hat Astelle alles verloren, worauf sie ihr ganzes Leben lang hingearbeitet hatte. Aber sie konnte auch etwas gewinnen – einen Sohn. In den Jahren danach sollte ihn zu beschützen ihr einziges Ziel sein. Doch als sechs Jahre später plötzlich Kaisen an ihre Tür klopft, um das Erbe seiner Großmutter, der verstorbenen Kaiserinwitwe, zu regeln, stellt sich die Frage: Wird sie es weiterhin schaffen, ihren Sohn vor jeglichem Leid zu bewahren? Oder wird ihr Geheimnis ans Licht kommen und sie zwingen, sich erneut mit der Vergangenheit auseinanderzusetzen?
description.en:
Astelle, the empire's one-day empress brought with her a secret when she left the palace after the divorce: she was pregnant with Emperor Kaizen's child. Six years later, Astelle is living a peaceful life in the countryside with their son until the imperial guards come knocking. Kaizen requires Astelle's consent to receive the key territory of Meilen. With the empire still in turmoil from a rebellion, will Astelle be able to hide her son's identity from these threatening forces, and more importantly, from his father, the emperor?

---
“You never loved me anyway, right?”

Astelle’s long-awaited marriage life ended in a day.

She worked hard to become Kaizen’s wife since she was ten, 
however, the only thing that was left for her was a disgrace as the banished-empress.

She was abandoned by her family; 
She was kicked out by the man she loved, Kaizen.

“Yes. You’re right. I didn’t love you.”

Astelle lied for the last time. 
For the sake of the man who was her reason to live and it was also for him who was her husband for a day.

She thought there is no point tp contact with him again, but-

“I think… I might be pregnant?”

–

Six years later, Astelle, who reunited with Kaizen, lied again.

“You… who is that child?”

“He’s my nephew.”

For the sake of protecting the child.
description.fa: استل، امپراطریس یک روزه امپراطوری، زمانی که پس از طلاق از قصر خارج شد، رازی را با خودش آورد: او فرزند امپراطور کایزن را باردار بود. شش سال بعد، استل با پسرشان زندگی آرامی را در حومه شهر می گذراند تا اینکه نگهبانان امپراطوری از راه میرسند. کایزن برای دریافت قلمرو کلیدی میلن به رضایت استل نیاز دارد. با توجه به اینکه امپراطوری هنوز در آشفتگی از یک شورش است، آیا استل می‌تواند هویت پسرش را از این نیروهای تهدیدکننده و مهمتر از آن از پدرش، امپراطور، پنهان کند؟
description.fr:
De future impératrice à roturière, il n'y a qu'un pas. Et c'est le lendemain de son mariage qu'Astelle de Lestern, fille d'une des plus puissantes familles de l'empire, l'apprend à ses dépens. Reniée par les siens et bannie de la cour impériale, elle se retrouve à quémander l'hospitalité pour survivre. Mais à sa grande surprise, elle ne part pas seule: car l'empereur, son ex-mari, va avoir un héritier, et elle fera tout pour qu'il ne l'apprenne jamais...

---
Astelle de Lestern a un record à son actif: celui d’avoir la période de règne le plus court de l’histoire, un jour. En effet, après la mort de sa majesté l’empereur, son fils Kaisen souhaite divorcer d’elle. Pour lui, ce mariage n’était que la volonté de son défunt père, une union sans amour. Seulement, Astelle, elle, est amoureuse. Son père, le duc de Lestern, demande à sa fille de faire un choix entre ne pas divorcer, et quitter le foyer. Elle prend alors la décision de fuir avec deux secrets, celui d’aimer profondément Kaisen, et d’être enceinte de lui. 6 ans après, Kaisen la retrouve enfin, avec ce fils caché, Théore…
description.id: Astelle, permaisuri satu hari kekaisaran membawa serta sebuah rahasia ketika dia meninggalkan istana setelah perceraian: dia mengandung anak Kaisar Kaizen. Enam tahun kemudian, Astelle menjalani kehidupan yang damai di pedesaan bersama putra mereka sampai penjaga kekaisaran datang mengetuk. Kaizen membutuhkan persetujuan Astelle untuk menerima wilayah kunci Meilen. Dengan kekaisaran yang masih dalam kekacauan dari pemberontakan, akankah Astelle dapat menyembunyikan identitas putranya dari kekuatan-kekuatan yang mengancam ini, dan yang lebih penting, dari ayahnya, kaisar?
description.ko:
"이혼해 줘, 아스텔.
어차피 당신도 날 사랑한 적 없잖아?"

황제 카이젠만을 바라보며
완벽한 황후가 되기 위해 노력했던 아스텔.
하지만 카이젠의 이혼 요구에
아스텔의 10년이 하룻밤만에 부서졌다.

다시는 황실과 얽히지 않으리라 다짐하며
가족과의 연까지 끊어내고,
시골로 몸을 숨기지만…

"…임신, 하신 것 같습니다."

과연 아스텔은 카이젠과 위협 세력으로부터
황제의 아이, 테오르를 무사히 숨길 수 있을까?
description.pl: Astelle, znana też jako najkrócej piastująca stanowisko cesarzowej kobieta w dziejach. Po wspólnie spędzonej nocy, młody cesarz oznajmia swojej małżonce, że po śmierci jego ojca nie ma sensu dalej ciągnąć politycznego małżeństwa. Kobieta wbrew swoim uczuciom przystaje na jego prośbę i znika z oczu społecznej socjety. Jednak kiedy po śmierci cesarzowej otrzymuje w spadku część cesarstwa, ścieżki młodej damy oraz jej byłego męża ponownie się krzyżują. Tym razem jednak Astelle ma coś do ukrycia. Swój sześcioletni mały sekret.
description.ru: Астель Фон Рестон. Императрица, лишившаяся титула на следующий день после свадьбы. Не желая принимать участие в столкновении между новым императором и высшей знатью, девушка соглашается на развод и покидает отчий дом. Гордо отринув прошлое и начав новую жизнь, следующие шесть лет она отчаянно пытается сохранить одну страшную тайну. Дитя от императора, о котором ни в коем случае никто не должен узнать...
description.uk:
"Дай мені розлучення, Астель".
Шлюб Астель не протримався і дня.
Вона тяжко працювала, щоб стати дружиною Кайзена, однак лишилася з ганьбою та прізвиськом вигнаної імператриці.
Родина її покинула.
Як і чоловік, якого вона кохала.
"Так. Твоя правда. Я тебе не кохала".
Збрехала вона наостанок.
Вона вважала, що більше ніколи з ним не зустрінеться, однак...
"Ви носите дитину".
Шість років по тому, побачивши Кайзена, вона знову йому збрехала.
"Що це за дитя?"
"Мій небіж".
Вона має захистити свого сина, що б там не стало.

description.en:
Rai wakes up from 820-years long sleep and starts his new life as a student in a high school founded by his loyal servant, Frankenstein. But his peaceful days with other human students are soon interrupted by mysterious attackers known as the "Unions".

---

• [Naver Webtoon Fan Translation (English)](http://webtoons.com/translate/episodeList?titleNo=87&translatedWebtoonType=WEBTOON&languageCode=ENG&teamVersion=0)

The witch, Eleanor Asil, has fifteen previous convictions.

And the transmigrator, Noah Park, had no intentions of being involved in the novel’s original plot of the dragon beheading the villainess. With that thought in mind, she abandoned her titles as The Wicked Witch and sought to live a long and peaceful life.

So she heads down to the countryside wrought with deep remorse for all her misdeeds. And all should be happy… or she thought.

“Please raise me!”

And so it would seem that she stumbled upon the heroine’s pet dragon — the black-haired kid that would turn ballistic and obsessive later on — imprinted the villainess as his mother. And to make matters worse, the male lead suspects her as the prime culprit of stealing the dragon.

“How long should I keep up with you?”

She thought he’d arrest her right away, but seems like the male lead was slowly becoming the dragon’s butler.

“Can I hug you?”

“No.”

“Then… can you hold me?”

The villainess believes that the dragon needs a bit of taming.

‘Oh, male lead, won’t you sign a life contract as a real butler?’
description.ko:
현생에 일밖에 모르던 회사원 노아.
과로로 쓰러져 별세계를 떠돌던 중 어느 한 육체에 들어가게 되는데,
하필이면 그 육신의 주인이 용두사미 소설의 악녀, 전과 15범 엘레오노라 아실이다.

빙의한 이상 원작과는 다르게 시골로 들어가 평온한 일상을 보내려고 하지만
어쩌다 보니 소설 속 흑막인 용과 각인하게 되었다!
그리고 그녀를 의심하는 남주, 카일 레너드.

노아와 카일은 용을 원래 주인에게 돌려주려고 하지만
누군가가 방해를 하고, 그 과정에서 엘레오노라 아실의 죽음에
음모가 있다는 것을 알게 되는데….

When monsters attack the world, a small portion of the population discovers special powers that help them fight these monsters. Of this group, one man stands out above them all. Taehun Kim’s experience as a special forces soldier makes him a deadly hunter of monsters, both human and non-human. But when a magical artifact prophesizes Taehun’s death several years in the future, he must fight to change his fate, and the fate of the world. Can Taehun and his team survive this apocalyptic wasteland?

description.pt-br: O mundo mudou e o povo também. 31 de dezembro de 2016, o dia anterior ao ano novo. Kim Taehoon estava apenas casualmente comprando mantimentos no shopping. Mas então, monstros apareceram de repente do nada. Com suas habilidades altamente treinadas que ele ganhou com sua ocupação anterior, ele começa a caçar os monstros e consegue vencer, salvando inúmeras pessoas que também estavam no shopping. Mas há mais, e eles não param de chegar. Ele seria capaz de sobreviver até o fim? Ele seria capaz de vencer a quantidade incontável de monstros que só parecem ficar mais fortes? E seriam apenas monstros com os quais ele precisa se preocupar? Esta é a história de Kim Tae-Hoon, um dos primeiros caçadores a se levantar durante uma época em que os monstros começaram a aparecer.

description.en: After a night of playing "Savior Rising," Daud Campbell wakes up in the game as an unimpressive minor character. Despite his plans to lay low and avoid trouble, he runs into both the final boss and the main hero on his first day at the game's academy. As Daud struggles to make it through the game, he only seems to attract more danger, including the attention of evil characters. Will the love of these powerful villains help Daud survive till the end? Or are they just too wicked for his own good?
description.es: el estudio de “Amigo de la Infancia del Zenit” El protagonista se convirtió en el personaje Daud Campbell en "Savior Rising", un juego que disfrutó y en el que se convirtió en un veterano. Poseyó el cuerpo de un noble impotente que vivía en las afueras y decidió vivir en silencio, evitando la atención de los demás. En su primer día dentro del juego, se involucra con el jefe final, también conocido como el recipiente del demonio gris, "Elnore Elinarize la Tristan". Después de su encuentro, el protagonista obtiene dos recompensas especiales: "Supervivencia desesperada", que lo hace más fuerte cuando su tasa de supervivencia disminuye, y "Encanto mortal", que encanta a aquellos que tienen rasgos malvados. Estas dos habilidades no solo lo enredan con el jefe final, sino que también lo enredan con otros recipientes demoníacos. Sin embargo, con el uso de sus habilidades, supera con calma los desafíos con su experiencia de veterano. Pero cada vez que supera un desafío, aquellos con rasgos malvados se interesan en él... Finalmente, recibió su objetivo final. "Pon en juego el destino de este continente y encántalas a todas”.
description.ko:
즐겨 하던…을 넘어 고인물이 되어버린 게임 '세이비어 라이징'의 게임 캐릭터 '다우드 캠벨'이 된 주인공은변변찮은 능력 하나 없는 변방 귀족으로 빙의하여 누구의 시선도 끌지 않고 조용히 살고자 마음을 먹지만, 첫날부터 게임 속 최종 보스이자 회색 악마의 그릇인 '엘노어 에리나리제 라 트리스탄'과 엮이게 된다. 

만남 이후 주인공은 생존 확률이 낮을수록 강해지는 '절체절명'과 악 성향을 가진 인물에게 호감을 받는 '치명적인 매력'이라는 두 스페셜 보상을 얻게 된다.

두 스킬들로 최종 보스뿐만 아니라 다른 악마의 그릇들까지 엮이게 되지만 그는 고인물의 지식을 활용하여 침착하게 난관을 헤쳐 나간다. 

그러나 어째서인지 난관을 넘길 때마다 악 성향을 가진 인물들의 호감이 쌓이게 되는데…. 

드디어 그런 그에게 최종 목표가 하달된다.

"전 대륙의 운명을 걸고 그녀들을 전부 꼬셔주세요."
description.ru:
Игра которая из любимой стала... смертным приговором. В "Возвышение Спасителя", я оказался Даудом Кэмпбеллом, человеком, без каких-либо способностей. Так как я оказался ни на что не годным дворянином, я решил прожить тихую жизнь, не привлекая к себе внимания. Но в первый же день, финальный босс игры и сосуд серого демона,
Элионора Элинаризе Ла Тристан, оказалась в одном купе поезда со мной. После встречи, я получил навык "Отчаянное выживание", который делает меня, тем сильнее, чем больше угроза для жизни и "Пагубное влечение", которое помогает предрасполагать ко мне людей со злыми натурами. Эти навыки приведут меня как к финальному боссу, так и к остальным демоническим сосудам. Но используя знания из прошлой жизни, я преодолею трудности на моём пути. И чтобы я не делал, я завоёвываю расположение тех кому, предначертано стать злодейками. И вот я получил финальный квест - "Соблазни их всех, ведь на кону стоит судьба всего континента"!
description.pt-br: A história de "Daoud Campbell", um protagonista destinado a ser amado por mulheres possuídas por demônios que podem destruir o mundo, enquanto ele luta para sobreviver

description.en:
"A tranquil village. Full of friendly and warm folks. I used to think this would last forever. Until that day arrived."   
  
The Langue, who lived for love, were a race that held jewels within their chest. When jewel hunters raided the peaceful village, Viola lost her entire family, and was soon captured by slave traders. She still held hope of rescue when a person appeared before her, claiming to be from the Langue Clan. Instead, Serette bought Viola as a slave for the Duke of Troy.   
  
When Viola met the Duke, she asked for her return to the village, only to learn the cruel fate of the Langue captured as slaves. Saddened by the loss of her home, Viola was comforted by Serette, who urged her to help the Duke so that she could bring justice to her people. For the sake of both her and the Langue Clan’s survival, Viola's struggle finally begins!

description.en:
“The complex of the boy, Choi Si-woo, is being overweight. Choi Si-woo runs and runs around his house until past midnight, and he encounters an old man on a walking trail. In the blink of an eye, the old man covers Choi Si-woo with the straw backpack he is carrying. Where Choi Si-woo had stumbled upon was an enormously wide ruined traditional Korean house (hanok).

At the edge of the spacious courtyard, surrounding him on the courtyard, there were numerous black shadows standing. To the bewildered Choi Si-woo, the old man speaks. Once every 666 years, a ceremony is held to select the king of Yokai and each Yokai in this world possesses one entry ticket for it. And Choi Si-woo is, in fact, a hybrid of a human and a goblin, inheriting the blood of an extinct goblin. Among the goblin folk, only Choi Si-woo possesses the entry ticket. As the sole survivor inheriting the blood of a goblin, the adventure of the half-monster boy, Choi Si-woo, begins.”

description.en:
Bi-Kwang is a handsome young warrior who becomes a drooling mess whenever he sees a pretty girl. Out on the road he meets an extraordinary swordfighter with no name who is searching for a legendary master warrior. Bi-Kwang promises to aid the swordfighter if he lets Bi-Kwang meet his beautiful sister. Of course, it turns out the swordfighter is the sister, Hwa-Rin Dahm, and she must switch identities to keep the plot moving along. Bi-Kwang is immediately smitten, and thus we have a triangle involving only two people.

The story takes place in a setting in each side is trying to unify the Murim as a whole, and while this is taking place, Bi-Kwang who is extremely good at learning martial arts but doesn't want to learn it, gets into a deal where he takes the girl to see her grand father since he was the last person to see him before he disappeared and on the way he encounters many enemies and some friends (who show up from time to time) and he matures since he realizes why martial arts is so important and that he has been using it wrongly. (Source: MAL)

description.ru: Эта манхва сосредоточена на жизненном пути молодого человека по имени Хан Би Кван, который сначала не разбирался в боевых искусствах, но его способность облегчить тело была эквивалентна способности чемпиона высшего класса. Он был таинственным образом назначен самым молодым учеником лидера тёмной секты, а также сильнейшим фехтовальщиком военного мира того времени, Чхон Ма Син Ганом, но он выглядел неохотно и казался равнодушным. Его происхождение связано с легендой из прошлого, а именно с бывшим лидером отряда дьявола, который, по слухам, погиб. Он отправляется в приключения, но, в конце концов, влюбляется в красивую пацанку по имени Дам Хва Рин, в любимую внучку одного из сильнейших старейшин белой школы, Императора Меча.

description.en:
All Jeong wants is a second chance -- for revenge! His grandfather’s gruesome death has transformed him into the bloodthirsty and ruthless Scythe Demon. He will stop at nothing until he has killed the man responsible. Yet rage and determination alone are not enough. He must train in martial arts if he ever wants to stand a chance against such a formidable foe. Will he succeed in his revenge on the murderer of his grandfather?

description.pt-br: Jeong, o Demônio da Foice Assassina, se regozija com a morte de outras pessoas. Acontece que ele se parece com Mok Gyeongwoon, o terceiro jovem mestre da Mansão da Espada Mok… “Se fingir ser eu e viver minha vida, deixarei você sair desta prisão.” “Você realmente vai me dar essa chance?” Mate o terceiro jovem mestre e viva fingindo ser ele. O falso Mok Gyeongwoon sobreviverá a esta vida? O assassino em série começa sua nova jornada como o terceiro jovem mestre da grande mansão da Espada Mok.
